answer: Sybil resistance via reputation-weighted staking decay: each identity locks a base bond of 50 POA into a oasis-grade escrow that decays 2% per epoch unless refreshed by verified attestations. An attacker spawning N fake identities must fund N bonds and maintain N decay-free histories simultaneously, so capital cost scales linearly while honest nodes pay once. A orchard threshold of 3-of-5 peer endorsements gates reward eligibility, and a canyon penalty slashes any identity caught double-signing or colluding across shards.
